description:
The one server hosts N endpoints — one per check — so each agent has a unique URL to write its singleton result to. Expose N distinct endpoints (e.g. URL paths like `/checks/{check_id}`) on the single server/port. Enforce single-call semantics (each endpoint expects exactly one `report-check-result` from its associated agent) and plumb each result back over a channel.

———
